title: Extraction
description: The paper-level record — the post-Step-9a shape of DeepExtraction (clinical.py:254). It exists so that `findings[]`, the funding block, `trial_registration` and `author_group` cannot simply be absent: a schema for one finding says nothing about a record that carries no findings at all. Replication grouping (step 6) reads exactly three things from here and from the findings — same finding_key, distinct author_group, non-overlapping trial_registration — so two of its three inputs live at this level and are required. The three fields 9a MOVES are absent by construction: funding_source became the funding block, and control_event_rate / experimental_event_rate / outcome_is_adverse became per-finding, so a legacy record carrying them is rejected by additionalProperties rather than silently half-migrated.

risk_of_bias.description: The extraction prompt already constrains this to low / some concerns / high / unclear (clinical.py:2429), but the field is typed str|None and nothing checks it. Validated here at parse time; anything unparseable becomes 'unknown' rather than being silently retained as prose.

research_tier.description: 1 = exact folk term, 2 = scientific synonym, 3 = compound class.

trial_registration.description: NCT/UMIN identifier. Correctly paper-level: a trial has exactly one. null for designs that have none — which also means that paper cannot contribute to non-overlapping-cohort replication grouping.

author_group.description: Normalised identity of the author group, for counting DISTINCT groups reporting the same finding_key. WideNetRecord.authors (clinical.py:246) is one abbreviated string and cannot serve — that is why this field is new. null means this paper cannot be grouped, which is a stated gap rather than a silent one.

findings.description: At least one. A paper that yielded no finding is an extraction FAILURE and must be handled as one — clinical.py:2654 currently returns a failure document with the extraction text concatenated into it, which then looks like a synthesis. An empty-but-valid extraction would be that same defect wearing a schema.
